style: 3D cartoon, Pixar, deadpan satire, horror jump scare, hard noon sun
motion_rule: he never stops: a full sidewinding sprint from the first frame, the camera racing backwards ahead of him so the bill walls tear past every beat and his face stays to the lens; four times he throws himself bodily into the lens with his jaws wide; his head fills half the frame height, head-on and closer from 8.2; new shot size each beat, one action per beat, only one of them moves at a time; no push in, no rack focus
character: a thick olive python in a grey collector waistcoat, flat yellow eyes, deadpan face, fangs out
second_characters: ONE lean grey rat in a red visor sprinting at the lens, flinging bills
props: overdue bill sheets the rat flings, each with a big red circular stamp and a column of digits; loose bills gusting past his coils; a paper maw of folded bills, crease teeth
prop_continuity: the red stamp stays readable; the maw arrives already folded and is never built on screen; speech is only heard, never shown
environment: a narrow corridor, bricks of red stamped bills filling both walls to the ceiling, red then orange then violet

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: dry chesty male voice, deadpan, even 4.0 syllables/sec
audio.pacing: 0.0-1.5 one breath; pause 1.5-2.8; 2.8-4.4 one breath; pause 4.4-5.4; 5.4-9.0 one breath; after 9.0 not a word, sfx keep going
audio.lip_sync: his jaws open on every syllable, never a voice over
audio.sfx: scales hissing over stone all clip, paper storm, a heavy thud on each lunge, a wet gulp at 1.4, a rustling swallow at 7.0

timeline.a: the frame opens on his open jaws filling it, then he drops back to a full sprint, coils pumping, red bill walls tearing past
he snaps a flung bill out of the air in his jaws at full drive and it is gone in one gulp
he throws himself into the lens, jaws wide and fangs first, and drops back into the corridor still driving hard
he bursts head first out of the left wall into the lens, bricks of bills blowing apart around his head
his tail whips a wall stack and it bursts into a blizzard of bills, all of it streaking backwards past him
head on to the lens, still driving hard, bills wiping the lens
he strikes at the lens, fangs first, close enough to fill the frame, then whips back into the corridor
the paper maw drops into the corridor behind him and snaps twice at the rat heels while the rat sprints at the lens
he drives head on at the lens past violet walls, the maw swelling along behind him
the maw takes the rat whole from behind at a full run and the paper creases shut over him
a rat shaped bulge sprints on inside the paper level with the python, the legs still pumping
his head fills the frame head on, still driving hard, the paper rat pumping along beside him
he throws himself straight into the lens one last time and his open jaws swallow the whole frame

must_appear: he throws himself into the lens with jaws wide at 1.5, 2.2, 4.4 and 9.0; at 6.4 the maw takes the rat from behind; from 7.2 a rat shaped bulge keeps sprinting inside the paper with the legs pumping
negative_prompt: speech bubble, comic panel, subtitles, watermark, letterbox, night, a parked camera, a still background, a stopped snake, a snake in ambush, a hero standing to work on a prop, a wide or distant hero, a hero seen from behind, a hero moving away from the lens, a held pose, two actions at once, slow motion, cyrillic letters, speech after 9.0
